page.overview:
Who is Audio Recording Specialist?

The audio recording specialist records the voices for toys that are created in Springfield. Lisa Simpson utilizes his service to record the audio for the Lisa Lionheart doll, though is frustrated by her obsessive thoughts about how and what to talk about.

By contrast, Krusty the Clown also recorded audio for his doll, but unlike Lisa he recorded his audio fast and without any emotion, and left before the recording specialist could even start recording.
